title: Book 1 — Clio, Chapter 21
paragraphs: When Alyattes received the oracle's answer, he at once sent a herald to Miletus, proposing a truce with Thrasybulus and the Milesians for as long as it would take to rebuild the temple. The man was sent off as envoy to Miletus; and Thrasybulus, informed of the whole matter in advance and knowing what Alyattes intended to do, devised this stratagem: he had all the supplies of provisions in the city — his own and those belonging to private citizens — gathered together in the marketplace, and he proclaimed to the Milesians that when he gave the signal they should all start drinking and making merry together.
